description:
On November 14, 2025, it was announced at BravoCon that Lala Kent and Tom Schwartz would be joining the cast in a full-time capacity.[20]
The majority of the cast returned for the third season, with the exception of Jax Taylor and Aaron Nosler, alongside Kent and Schwartz. Lacy Nicole joined the cast in a friend capacity. The third season premiered on April 1, 2026.
